 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0038
 James Castillo, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
February 22, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Kyle Sanders, Marshall & Dominguez LLP
PARTIES
Plaintiff James Castillo is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a vehicle involved in the collision described
below. Defendant is an automobile insurance carrier authorized to transact business in the State of Texas, which issued the policy
of insurance under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and which is responsible for the claims handling and contractual obligations
described herein.
FACTS
On February 24, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully operating a vehicle in Pearland and was in the process of turning left at an
intersection when another vehicle struck Plaintiff's car. The impact occurred while Plaintiff was lawfully proceeding through the
turn and was not the result of any act or omission by Plaintiff. Following the collision, Plaintiff reported the loss to Defendant and
submitted the documentation requested under the policy. Defendant's handling of the claim has not resulted in payment sufficient
to cover Plaintiff's medical care and losses, and Plaintiff has been required to pursue this action to obtain the benefits due under
the policy.
NEGLIGENCE
The driver of the other vehicle owed a duty to exercise ordinary care in operating a motor vehicle, including the duty to keep a
proper lookout, to control speed, and to yield the right of way where required. That driver breached those duties, and the breach
proximately caused the collision. Defendant, as the insurer obligated under the polciy to pay covered losses and to handle claims
in good faith, owed Plaintiff duties of fair dealing, prompt investigation, and reasonable settlement once liability became
reasonably clear. Defendant breached those duties by failing to adequately evaluate the cliam and by delaying or underpaying
benefits that were reasonably owed.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff sustained whiplash and related soft tissue injuries to the neck and back, accompanied
by pain, stiffness, headaches, and limited range of motion. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses for examination, imaging, and
treatment, and will likely require further care. Plaintiff has also suffered lost earnings, diminished capacity to perform daily
activities, and mental anguish. Plaintiff seeks actual damages, statutory interest, attorney's fees, and court costs as permitted by
Texas law, in an amount of $206,000.00.
